lines.zh: 沙沙地移动着，皮肤闪烁着蓝光。
lines.en: Moving with a沙沙sound, its skin glows blue.

lines.zh: 灰色皮肤覆盖着，如同幽灵般飘过。
lines.en: Grey skin covering, it floats like a ghost.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的吟唱，似乎在寻找猎物。
lines.en: Releasing a low chant, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 凝视远方，似乎在计划着下一步。
lines.en: Staring into the distance, planning its next move.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中慢慢前行，皮肤反射出微弱光芒。
lines.en: Moving slowly in the dark, its skin reflects faint light.

lines.zh: 发出微弱的魔法吟唱，准备攻击。
lines.en: Releasing a weak magic chant, preparing to attack.

lines.zh: 灰化的皮肤中，隐藏着致命的魔力。
lines.en: Its gray skin conceals deadly magic.

lines.zh: 移动时发出轻微的呼吸声。
lines.en: Releasing a soft breath as it moves.

lines.zh: 在阴影中潜行，等待着猎物。
lines.en: Moving stealthily in the shadows, waiting for prey.
Skin greying, yet my pace stays quick.
I cross the nightmare's third-level halls.

lines.zh: 静静地站在那里，仿佛一尊雕像。
皮肤在黑暗中闪烁，如同夜空中的星光。
lines.en: Its skin glows in the dark, like starlight.

lines.zh: 我皮肤变灰时，刀砍不进去。
lines.en: When my skin turns grey, blades don't cut.

lines.zh: 静静地站着，等待着猎物的到来。
皮肤上布满神秘的符文，静静散发着魔法气息。
lines.en: Its skin is covered in mysterious runes, softly radiating magic.

lines.zh: 静静地站立着，等待机会。
lines.en: Standing quietly, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 身体微微抖动，似乎在感受周围的气息。
lines.en: Its body trembles, sensing the surroundings.

lines.zh: 静静地观察着，寻找着下一个目标。
lines.en: Observing silently, searching for the next target.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中保持警惕，静待机会。
lines.en: Staying alert in the darkness, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 静静地等待，似乎在倾听什么。
灰色在皮肤上慢慢漫开。

lines.en: I count the cracks in the stone.

lines.zh: 皮肤一暗，我就什么都不怕。
lines.en: Skin darkens, and nothing can hurt me.

lines.zh: 我把脸转向梦魇的深处。
lines.en: I turn my face to the nightmare's depths.
My breathing echoes down the hall.

lines.zh: 目光锐利地盯着玩家，准备攻击。
lines.en: Its sharp gaze fixed on the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 迅速转向玩家，发出警告的低吼。
lines.en: Swiftly turning towards the player, emitting a warning growl.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，皮肤开始泛灰。
lines.en: Fixing its gaze on the player, its skin turning gray.

lines.zh: 目光穿过黑暗，锁定玩家的位置。
lines.en: Its gaze piercing through the darkness, locking onto the player.

lines.zh: 注视着玩家，准备使用它的魔力。
lines.en: Fixing its gaze on the player, ready to use its magic.

lines.zh: 目光闪烁着蓝色光芒，瞄准玩家。
lines.en: Its eyes glowing blue, aiming at the player.

lines.zh: 眼神中的魔法能量开始聚集。
lines.en: Magic energy gathering in its gaze.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，皮肤开始变得灰暗。
lines.en: Fixing its gaze on the player, its skin turning gray.

lines.zh: 死死盯着玩家，准备施放魔法。
lines.en: Staring intently at the player, ready to cast magic.

lines.zh: 紧盯着玩家，准备发起攻击。
lines.en: Fixing its gaze on the player, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 我看着你，皮肤褪成灰色。
lines.en: I watch you; my skin fades to grey.
You strike me once; I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 我记住你站在哪一块砖上。
lines.en: I note which slab you stand on.

lines.zh: 不要靠近我，不然你会后悔！
lines.en: Stay back, or you’ll regret it!

lines.zh: 你递来的东西，我先用指甲试。
lines.en: I test what you offer with a fingernail first.
When my skin turns grey, nothing cuts me.

lines.zh: 我的灰皮肤擦过你的肩膀。
lines.en: My gray skin grazes your shoulder.
Don’t get close to my core!

lines.zh: 皮肤变灰时，也想找个伴。
lines.en: Even with grey skin, I want a mate.

lines.zh: 灰色的我，在暗处等你回应。
lines.en: Gray as I am, I wait in the dark for your answer.

lines.zh: 皮肤变灰时，我谁都不认得。
lines.en: When my skin greys, I know no one.

lines.zh: 在这层梦魇里，我只认一个。
lines.en: In this layer of nightmare, I recognize only one.

lines.zh: 我指尖一夹，把那块石头收走。
lines.en: I pinch the stone between my fingers and take it.

lines.zh: 你离我的范围越来越近。
我的锁定不会轻易解除。

lines.en: You have entered the third level.
The magic in my palm turns your way.

lines.zh: 我的攻击将是你最后的记忆。
lines.en: My attack will be your last memory.

lines.zh: 我会用你的灵魂填满虚空。
lines.en: I'll fill the void with your soul.
I turn to grey statue and advance.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍在灰皮上，滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slides off my grey hide.

lines.zh: 我在你面前一点一点变灰。
lines.en: I grey over, bit by bit, before you.
Gray skin, you can't handle it!
Touch me, get struck by lightning!
I wait beneath the rock layers!
I emerge from the dark depths!
I appear on the edge of dreams!
I wander between the rock walls!

lines.zh: 梦魇第三层，我睁开眼睛。
lines.en: On the nightmare's third level I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 石壁裂开，灰色的我走出来。
lines.en: The wall splits; grey, I step out.
Magic arrives first; the body follows.

lines.zh: 我从梦的褶皱里站起身。
lines.en: I stand up out of a fold in the dream.
